A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Still have something on your mind?

Which English qualifications do you cover?+

Explore tuition for O Level, IGCSE, AS Level and A Level English Language and Literature. Share your exam board and syllabus with the academy to confirm the right course and teacher.

Are all lessons online?+

Yes. Lessons are online, with one-to-one and group options for students across the GCC and beyond. The academy will help you arrange a suitable time.

Can I try a lesson before joining?+

Yes, your first trial is free. Contact the academy to discuss your course and agree a trial time. Your place is confirmed when the team agrees the arrangements with you.

Do you offer hourly or monthly lessons?+

Both hourly and monthly arrangements are planned. Discuss current availability, lesson frequency and fees directly with the academy.

What if I don't know my exam board?+

That's a good place to start a conversation. Share your qualification and any course information you have, and the academy can help identify the relevant syllabus.
